title: Trend Extraction
description: Trend Extraction is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Extracts the underlying trend from noisy usage history. A moving median strips spikes; the trend line is the slope of the cleaned series. It takes usage history and produces trend line. Tunable parameters: median window 7. Guarantee: spikes never move the trend.

fields.mechanism: A moving median strips spikes; the trend line is the slope of the cleaned series.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Seasonality Detection
description: Seasonality Detection is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Detects weekly and daily usage seasons automatically. Autocorrelation on the series finds repeating periods; seasons are modeled separately. It takes usage history and produces season model. Tunable parameters: periods 24 h, 7 d. Guarantee: detected seasons are always validated.

fields.mechanism: Autocorrelation on the series finds repeating periods; seasons are modeled separately.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Growth Projection
description: Growth Projection is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Projects usage forward with confidence bands. The trend extends linearly with bands widened by historical variance. It takes trend and produces projection. Tunable parameters: 30/90 d. Guarantee: bands always widen with horizon.

fields.mechanism: The trend extends linearly with bands widened by historical variance.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Capacity Alerts
description: Capacity Alerts is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Alerts when projected usage crosses capacity. Projections are checked against capacity daily; crossings within the warning window page. It takes projection, capacity and produces alerts. Tunable parameters: 14 d window. Guarantee: alerts always name the date of crossing.

fields.mechanism: Projections are checked against capacity daily; crossings within the warning window page.
fields.guarantees: alerts always name the date of crossing

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: What-If Scenarios
description: What-If Scenarios is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Models usage under hypothetical changes. Users adjust growth or add events; the model replays history with the change applied. It takes scenario params and produces scenario projection. Tunable parameters: interactive. Guarantee: scenarios never alter real history.

fields.mechanism: Users adjust growth or add events; the model replays history with the change applied.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Anomaly Flagging
description: Anomaly Flagging is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Flags usage spikes that break the forecast. Residuals beyond 3 sigma are flagged with the probable cause category. It takes forecast, actuals and produces flags. Tunable parameters: 3σ. Guarantee: flags always show expected vs actual.

fields.mechanism: Residuals beyond 3 sigma are flagged with the probable cause category.
fields.guarantees: flags always show expected vs actual

title: Per-Service Forecasts
description: Per-Service Forecasts is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Forecasts each service separately, then sums. Services are modeled independently; the total is the sum with combined bands. It takes service series and produces service forecasts. Tunable parameters: per service. Guarantee: the total always equals the sum.

fields.mechanism: Services are modeled independently; the total is the sum with combined bands.
fields.guarantees: the total always equals the sum

title: Cost Projection
description: Cost Projection is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Turns usage forecasts into dollar forecasts. Forecasted units multiply by current price cards; price changes are modeled as scenarios. It takes usage forecast and produces cost forecast. Tunable parameters: per unit pricing. Guarantee: costs always use current prices.

fields.mechanism: Forecasted units multiply by current price cards; price changes are modeled as scenarios.

title: Headroom Reporting
description: Headroom Reporting is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Reports days of headroom left at current growth. Headroom is (capacity − now) / growth rate, recomputed daily. It takes usage, capacity and produces days of headroom. Tunable parameters: daily. Guarantee: headroom never goes negative silently.

fields.mechanism: Headroom is (capacity − now) / growth rate, recomputed daily.

title: Forecast Accuracy
description: Forecast Accuracy is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Scores past forecasts against actuals to keep the model honest. MAPE is computed per horizon; models worse than the naive baseline are retired. It takes forecasts, actuals and produces accuracy score. Tunable parameters: MAPE. Guarantee: bad models are always retired.

fields.mechanism: MAPE is computed per horizon; models worse than the naive baseline are retired.

title: Event Injection
description: Event Injection is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Injects known future events — launches, migrations — into the forecast. Events add their expected load profile to the baseline projection. It takes event list and produces adjusted forecast. Tunable parameters: per event. Guarantee: events never double-count.

fields.mechanism: Events add their expected load profile to the baseline projection.

title: Multi-Resource Correlation
description: Multi-Resource Correlation is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Finds resources whose usage moves together. Pairwise correlation across resource series reveals coupled capacity needs. It takes resource series and produces correlation map. Tunable parameters: r threshold 0.7. Guarantee: correlations are always labeled, not assumed causal.

fields.mechanism: Pairwise correlation across resource series reveals coupled capacity needs.
fields.guarantees: correlations are always labeled, not assumed causal

title: Cold-Start Forecasts
description: Cold-Start Forecasts is a planning ability in the Resource Usage Forecasting database. Forecasts for new services with no history using similar-service priors. The new service borrows the shape of the most similar existing service, scaled. It takes similar services and produces prior forecast. Tunable parameters: similarity scored. Guarantee: priors are always marked as estimates.

fields.mechanism: The new service borrows the shape of the most similar existing service, scaled.
fields.guarantees: priors are always marked as estimates

fields.mechanism: The API returns projections with bands for any resource and horizon.

Guarantee: numbers in prose always match the charts.
